sections.t: Rest day planned and nothing logged, so right on plan. Week 1 is now underway.

Week 1, Lower A: hip thrust 4x6-10, squat 3x6-10, Bulgarian split squat 3x8-12, hip abduction 3x15-20, lying leg raise 3x10-15. No run today. Pick weights you can lift for the bottom of each rep range with 1 to 2 reps left, so you have room to progress.

Lifting day, so spread the 130 g protein across 3 to 4 meals and put some carbs around the session. Try Protein overnight oats before training and the Chicken and potato tray bake afterwards, staying near 1,750 kcal.
